pages.title: Cobourg
pages.description: town in Ontario, Canada
pages.extract: Cobourg is a town of 19,000 people (2016) on the north shore of Lake Ontario in Northumberland County, southern Ontario. It is approximately midway between downtown Toronto and Kingston.

pages.extract: Fallon is a city in Central Nevada. Fallon is a city in one of Nevada's few agricultural areas. The farms are irrigated using water extracted from the Carson River near the river's terminus into the Carson Sink.

pages.title: Ozamiz
pages.description: city of the Philippines in the province of Misamis Occidental
pages.extract: Ozamiz, known as the "Gem of the Panguil Bay" and the "Gateway to Northwestern Mindanao", is a city in Misamis Occidental in Northern Mindanao. With a population of 143,620 (2024), it is the largest city in the province.

pages.title: San Teodoro (Sardinia)
pages.description: Italian comune in Sardinia
pages.extract: San Teodoro, the southern doorway to Sardinia's "Emerald Coast", is 25 km from Olbia.

pages.title: Sokaraja
pages.description: district in Banyumas Regency, Central Java Province, Indonesia
pages.extract: Sokaraja is a town in Banyumas Regency, Central Java, Indonesia, close to Purwokerto. It is famous for the local snack getuk goreng.

pages.title: Walt Disney World/Epcot
pages.description: Walt Disney World Resort's second theme park, with attractions based on international culture and human achievement
pages.extract:
Epcot is an expansive theme park where you can visit Mexico, France, and China, all in the same afternoon; survive crash tests in an experimental car; soar around the world with the wind in your hair; and learn all about human achievement and international cooperation.
Comprising World Showcase and Future World, Epcot is  in the heart of the Walt Disney World Resort, close to several luxurious hotels, and to the dining and entertainment district called Disney's BoardWalk.

pages.title: Lake Park
pages.description: city in Lowndes County, Georgia, United States of America
pages.extract: Lake Park is a city in the southern portion of Lowndes County. It is the last city on Interstate 75 before you enter Florida.

pages.title: Apizaco
pages.description: municipal seat of Apizaco, State of Tlaxcala, Mexico
pages.extract: Apizaco is a bustling commercial town of 82,000 people (2016) in Tlaxcala state. Apizaco's not scenic or tourist-oriented, and its main interest for travellers is likely to be as a jumping-off place for climbing the volcano La Malinche.

pages.title: Champlain and Rouses Point
pages.description: village in Clinton County, New York, United States
pages.extract: Champlain  and Rouses Point are a pair of adjacent villages in Northern New York on the U.S.-Canada border. The villages, 20 miles (30 km) north of Plattsburgh and 40 miles (60 km) south of Montreal, are the northernmost in the state of New York.

pages.title: World War II in Europe
pages.description: huge area of heavy fighting across Europe
pages.extract:
World War II or the Second World War took place over many continents: while the Pacific War took place in Asia and Oceania, the European theatre saw combat from September 1939 to May 1945. The war was by far the most destructive conflict in European history in terms of loss of human lives as well as historic architecture.
The European theatre included North Africa; see World War II in Africa.

pages.title: Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument
pages.description: national monument in the United States
pages.extract:
Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument is a national monument in the remote northwest of Arizona with an area of 4,115.6 km2 (1,589.0 sq mi), protecting the western edge of the Grand Canyon and lots of desert. The national monument's name is often shortened to Parashant National Monument, often to prevent confusion with the Grand Canyon National Park. 
Many GPS systems tend to confuse Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument with the Grand Canyon National Park and have been known to mislead travelers into visiting this remote, desolate and isolated part of the Southwest – if you're coming to this monument because your favorite map application told you to, be aware that this is not the Grand Canyon National Park. Try entering Grand Canyon Village instead.

pages.title: Faraya
pages.description: human settlement in Lebanon
pages.extract: Faraya (فريا) is a scenic alpine village and municipality in the Keserwan District of the Keserwan-Jbeil Governorate in Lebanon. Perched high in the Mount Lebanon range at an altitude varying between 1,600 and 2,000 meters above sea level, Faraya is famous as Lebanon's premier year-round mountain destination.
